The APC family includes the flexible and adaptable APC9/40 & 45/10mm, the rifle calibre APC223/556/300 line, and the ultimate in semiautomatic precision, the APC308. With a comprehensive suite of accessories created specifically for these platforms, the APC series represents a breakthrough in customisation and modularity for every operator, and every specialised mission.

Manufacturer: ARCHWICK (Licensed by Brugger & Thomet)

products.title: Umarex Silver Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver GEL BLASTER – by Wingun
products.body_html:
Step into the Wild West with the Wingun Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Gel Blaster — a fully functioning, single-action revolver styled after the legendary Colt Single Action Army, but built for gel-ball blasting fun. With a full-metal body, smooth cylinder cycling and CO₂ power-system built into the grip, this model delivers authentic feel and performance. With a vintage “antique black” finish and six-shot shell system, it’s as much a display piece as it is a thrill to shoot. Ideal for gel-ball skirmish, backyard fun or collector display, this revolver offers 300+ FPS performance and solid build quality that appeals to serious players and enthusiasts alike.

Whether you’re blasting gel balls in your CQB field or showing off the iconic Peacemaker silhouette on your wall, this Wingun model ticks both boxes. Just load in one of the six brass shells, attach a 12 g CO₂ cartridge (sold separately), load your 7-8 mm gel balls and you’re good to go.

Umarex Black Colt SAA Peacemaker .45 Revolver Features:

  • Full-metal body for realism and durability.
  • Realistic single-action revolver operation with smooth cylinder cycling.
  • CO₂ powered (12 g cartridge, non-threaded) system integrated into grip — no battery required.
  • Six-shot brass shell system (gel balls loaded into individual shells).
  • Antique black finish for classic styling.
  • High performance: approx. 300+ FPS (with suitable gel ball ammo and operating conditions).
  • Uses 7-8 mm gel ball ammo — prepare with proper gel-ball ammo for best results.
  • Ideal for collectors, gel-ball skirmish players, and display-ready revolver enthusiasts.

  • Operation: CO₂ powered single-action revolver
  • Cartridge System: Six brass shells included
  • Ammunition: 7-8 mm gel balls (gel-ball ammo)
  • FPS (approx): 300+ FPS (verified by retailer)
  • Power Source: 12g non-threaded CO₂ cartridge (not included)
  • Recommended Use: Gel-ball skirmish, backyard practice, display collector piece
  • Included in Box: 1 x revolver unit, 6 x brass shells

products.title: King Arms Full-Auto M2 Carbine Gas Blowback Gel Blaster
products.body_html:
Features

  • Heavy duty aluminium alloy barrel and trigger assembly
  • Real wood stock
  • Realistic gas blowback action to simulate the bolt cycling action & recoil
  • 35 round style green gas magazine
  • Built-in front & rear sling attachment points
  • Fixed front and adjustable rear sights
  • Wing protected front post sight
  • Select-fire capability, can be used in full-auto or semi-auto

The King Arms M1 Carbine replica is a beautiful reproduction of this classic firearm. Made with real wood and aluminium alloy, the rifle looks and feels authentic. Adding to the realism is a Co2/Green Gas powered gas recoil system which helps to imitate the bolt cycling action.

Although the M1 Carbine was famously known for it's capability, few know that originally the Carbine was meant to be select-fire capable, however during World War 2 it was easier to produce semi-auto M1s at the time. Towards the end the M2 was introduced, with a bayonet lug, and the select-fire capability added afterwards. During the Korean conflict, the M2 carbine saw more wider use and an experimental 30-round magazine was also issued along with it.

Specifications:

Length: 920mm
Weight: 2450g
Magazine Capacity: 25-30rds
Fire Modes: Semi-Auto, Full Auto, Safe
Package Includes: Gun, Magazine

About King Arms

King Arms was founded in 2004 with the mission to ensure optimum customer satisfaction by providing precision products and outstanding service. In 2015, we moved our headquarters from Hong Kong to Taiwan where we've continued to provide excellent products with the highest quality. While working with leading firearms manufactures, we provide to our customers a level of innovation and authenticity that can't be found anywhere else in the Gelsoft industry. This goal is what continuously drives us to improve and gives us purpose.

products.title: VFC Carl Gustaf USSOCOM M3 MAAWS Gas-Powered Gel Blaster Rocket / Grenade Launcher
products.body_html:
Features

  • Utilizes nylon fiber-reinforced polymer for the main structure, which greatly reduces the weight of the whole product. This provides a weight reduction from what would be 10 kg (if manufactured using original material) to about 4 kg with the VFC design
  • Internally, all key components are still made from metal so durability is retained where it matters most!
  • The first gel blaster  "bazooka" made by VFC
  • Realistic loading and firing operations help keep immersion at max
  • Built to externally replicate the real M3 as closely as possible with details like dummy rifling, realistic adjustable iron sights, and a realistic "venturi locking device" to seal the breach
  • Includes a simulated 84mm dummy rocket with the ability to add firing functionality
  • Install a standard 40mm gas grenade by removing the dummy rocket cap on the 84mm rocket, allowing you to fire gel balls or rubber caps!
  • Comes with a standard green gas-powered firing system
  • MIL-STD 1913 Picatinny rail for adding optics, lasers, or other accessories
  • Compatible with double bell gas grenade 

The Modern "Bazooka" of the US Special OperationsIn service around the world, the Carl Gustav recoilless rifle has also been continuously developed for new uses, including with the US special operations forces and the British SAS as a tool to deal with bunkers and combat vehicles. In November 2011, the U.S. Army ordered the M3 series for regular troops on the battlefield in Afghanistan to fight against RPG rocket launchers equipped by opposing forces. The effective range of the RPG rocket launcher is 500-600 meters. Compared with the M3 Carl Gustaf, with the combination of different ammunition types, the effective range can be increased to about 1300 meters. And as an added feature set through the use of proper munitions, it also has the ability of air bombing enemies hiding in bunkers from directly above.

On March 28, 2013, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) asked the manufacturer to reduce weight but gave strict instructions that the reduction in weight and size should not affect the weapon's center of gravity or durability. Saab Bofors Dynamics had also already developed a weight-reduced version prior to delivery to USSOCOM that had been shown in firing tests to have no performance degradation, no recoil increase, and barrel life essentially the same as the unmodified version.

Australia's FIRST Aluminium USP Gas Pistol!

Listed below are the Upgrade parts utilised in the build. 

Base Model : Tokyo Marui USP

Upgraded Features

  • Guarder CNC Aluminium Slide
  • Guarder Steel Extractor
  • Guarder Steel CNC Threaded Outer Barrel for MARUI USP (14mm Negative/Black)

Note: Current mag lips design allows for slide lock.

Black Mag Lip is a Durable Resin Print in an ABS-like compound included for this model. By purchasing you're also covered by our life time guarantee on mag lips with proper use.

Original Magazine included

“USP (Universal Self-loading Pistol)”, which uses a lightweight polymer (resin) frame and the world's first under rail as a standard, has a major impact on the style of tactical handguns that will appear in the future. It was.
Originally developed for the US market, USP's operation is close to handguns such as governments that are popular in the United States.

Tokyo Marui modelled Variant 1 with a combination of single & double action and control lever only on the left (with manual safety and de-cocking function) from a number of specification patterns. Based on the data measured from the real thing, the reproducibility is improved in every detail.

Major features

  • Large-diameter cylinder adoption
    A cylinder with a diameter of 15 mm is filled with gas for firing and blowback. Realised stable live performance and powerful blowback.
  • Safety & Decocking System
    By operating the control lever, it is possible to lock the hammer when it is in full cock (when it can be fired), and it is also possible to return from full cock to half cock in order to prevent it from falling out.
  • Reproduce the same operation as the real thing
    You can enjoy a single action that pulls the slide and raises the hammer to fire, and a double action that raises and fires the hammer just by pulling the trigger.
  • Metal extractor
    The extractor on the right side of the slide is reproduced with different parts. * Dummy that mimics only the appearance.
  • Under-mount rail included
    The under rail integrated with the frame is a unique standard. By attaching the included under-mount rail, it is possible to install a flashlight that supports the Picatinny standard with a width of 20 mm.
  • Ambi-type magazine catch lever
    Can be operated from either the left or right side.
  • Die-cast magazine
    Includes a die-cast magazine that resists cold.

Specification

  • Build Material : ABS
  • Magazine Capacity : 15-18
  • Length : 195mm
  • Barrel Length : ~95mm
  • Weight : 720g
  • System: Gas Blowback
  • Fire Mode : Semi Auto-Auto
  • Package Includes : Blaster, Magazine

Gas Type: 12kg Green Gas only for this pistol - PLEASE NOTE USING C02 IN THIS PISTOL WILL VOID WARRANTY. Duster Gas will still operate Steel Slide if choosing to use a lighter gas.

INCLUDES:

  • TM Gel Blaster H&K USP GBB Pistol x 1
  • Standard H&K USP Magazine x 1
  • Picatinny Rail Mount x 1

GEL GROWTH

  • We've Tested working; SUNMER CAT GREEN GELS for no more than 2.5 hour grow in water. Other hardened gels will work with various optimised growing times.

    3 Month Warranty on this product with proper use and Maintenance. Misuse will void your warranty.

GLOCK perfection for Gelsoft sports - only achievable through a perfectly balanced relationship between realism and match suitability.

In the gas-powered Gen5 version with Modular Optic System (MOS), ambitious players also benefit from the superior fifth-generation GLOCK features and a slide with an integrated mount for red dot sights. Red dots can be mounted with the Docter, Trijicon, C-More and Leupold footprints using separately available adapter plates.

On the playing field, the GLOCK 17 Gen5 MOS proves its superiority with first-class materials. Most striking of all: the CNC-machined aluminium slide with original markings and a deep matte black colour. Together with an optimum distribution of the propellant gas thanks to an innovative nozzle system, it provides a particularly strong blowback effect. With every shot, the player experiences authentic recoil action much more strongly and thus more realistically.

The GLOCK 17 Gen5 MOS achieves top-notch performance in precision. It is suitable for high-pressure gas up to 150 PSI and guarantees constant performance with a maximum of 1 joule. In addition to the option of mounting a red dot, the open sights are also compatible with the original accessories. The clearly discernible pressure point trigger breaks at a realistic 2.8 kg. The Shoot-Up is adjustable.

The look and feel of this Gel Blaster pistol is so close to the real steel original that it fits reliably in all compatible holsters. This image is also reflected in the 15-round magazine with its black magazine body with indicated viewing windows for loading status, which can be loaded using the included speed loader.

products.title: A&K Full Size M1 Garand Gel Blaster AEG with Real Wood Furniture
products.body_html:
Features

  • Full size replica of the trusted M1 Garand battle rifle w/ beautifully stained real wood furniture
  • Metal receiver and barrel assembly
  • Adjustable rear sight
  • Front and rear sling rings; Stacking swivel
  • Version 7 gearbox
  • Functioning trigger guard safety
  • Drop free magazine feeds from the bottom of the rifle; Low profile magazine release on the left side of the receiver maintains traditional M1 styling

The first standard issue semi-automatic rifle issued to the US Armed Forces, the M1 Garand was referred to as "the greatest battle implement ever devised" by General George S. Patton. Replacing the venerable Springfield M1903 in 1936, the M1 Garand quickly displayed its huge advantage on the battlefield. During World War II, the M1 Garand saw extensive use and gave US forces a major advantage in firefights against Axis soldiers who were usually issued slower bolt-action rifles. The M1 Garand remained in service throughout the Korean War and even had limited deployment in the early years of the Vietnam War. The rifle still continues to be used even in the modern day by drill teams and military honor guards as well as in the civilian market long after it was retired from active service.

A&K has faithfully reproduced the venerable M1 Garand in an AEG that everyone can afford. Striving to offer the most realism and reliability for your dollar, the A&K M1 Garand features a stained wood stock and a metal alloy receiver and barrel assembly giving this M1 a realistic look and feel that will have you believing you are pushing through the hedgerows in the south of France. Internally the A&K M1 Garand is powered by a version 7 gearbox allowing a level of customisation and upgradeability not found in other M1 AEG replicas on the market. While all the major features of a good M1 Garand replica are there, A&K did not skimp on the details including a period correct safety, bayonet lug, sling rings stacking swivel and an authentic sight picture. Whether you are a WWII re-enactor or an gel blaster player looking to field a unique rifle, the A&K M1 Garand delivers on looks, performance, realism and usability that puts it at the front of the pack.

Manufacturer: A&K

Gearbox: Ver 7br

products.title: Puff Dino Green Gas Bottle
products.body_html:
PUFF DINO Green Gas for gel blasters is manufactured by the leader manufacturer of aerosol products in Taiwan. PUFF DINO gas is from an ISO 9001 certificated production line, so it can keeps in a stable high quality.
We add suitable silicone oil to aid smoothness and power of every shot.

Special Online Only Offer: Add 3 or more to your cart for an Automatic Discount!

SPECIAL FEATURES

  • Our product is using high power quality gas that perfectly mixed with silicon to improve your gun performance.
  • Silicon mixed will protect your gun; lubricant parts while you are shooting and upgrade every shooting experience you have.
  • The reason why we added silicon is due to liquefied gas will causing instant frozen effect right after leave the pressurized cylinder and making plastic/rubber parts hardened and brittle.
  • With our high-quality silicone added, it will help to prevent parts accelerate aging. Therefore enhances maintenance and smoothness in shooting.
  • This will also save you from time-consuming process like separating internal parts to lubricating them individually.
  • The metal nuzzle design will increase the life of usage and prevent leakage of green gas. By using green gas, our product is eco-friendly and harmless to the environment.

HOW TO USE

  • Hold the green gas cylinder upside down and press the cylinder nozzle straight down into the magazine valve.
  • Once you see the green gas leak out from magazine valve; it means there are enough gas filled and stop filling immediately.
  • The gas pressure would differ by the temperature.

  • Product Size: 6.5 cm x 6.5 cm x 29.0 cm
  • Ingredient : C3H8, Silicone Oil.

This is a custom slide kit designed for Tokyo Marui Gas Blowback Gun High Capa 5.1 series. The slide is divided into front and rear sections and features dedicated internal parts for weight reduction and short stroke functionality. This design increases the blow back speed while significantly reducing recoil shock. As a result, you can achieve precise shooting without compromising accuracy, even during rapid firing. The slide stop notch position has been adjusted to ensure proper functionality while maintaining a short stroke. The front half of the slide (front block) is made of aluminium alloy, functioning as a counterweight to minimise muzzle movement during continuous firing. The kit is equipped with an O-ring to securely hold the outer barrel in place. In addition to the standard Picatinny rail on the frame, you can also attach rail panels to the front block. Since the front block is independent of the slide, it won't interfere with the slide's operation even when mounting optics or other accessories. With the addition of a fore grip and a dot sight, you can unleash a firepower that surpasses expectations for a handgun.

GLOCK perfection for Gelsoft sports - only achievable through a perfectly balanced relationship between realism and match suitability.

In the gas-powered Gen5 version with Modular Optic System (MOS), ambitious players also benefit from the superior fifth-generation GLOCK features and a slide with an integrated mount for red dot sights. Red dots can be mounted with the Docter, Trijicon, C-More and Leupold footprints using separately available adapter plates.

On the playing field, the GLOCK 19 Gen5 MOS proves its superiority with first-class materials. Most striking of all: the CNC-machined aluminium slide with original markings and a deep matte black colour. Together with an optimum distribution of the propellant gas thanks to an innovative nozzle system, it provides a particularly strong blowback effect. With every shot, the player experiences authentic recoil action much more strongly and thus more realistically.

The GLOCK 19 Gen5 MOS achieves top-notch performance in precision. It is suitable for high-pressure gas up to 150 PSI and guarantees constant performance with a maximum of 1 joule. In addition to the option of mounting a red dot, the open sights are also compatible with the original accessories. The clearly discernible pressure point trigger breaks at a realistic 2.8 kg. The Shoot-Up is adjustable.

“USP (Universal Self-loading Pistol)”, which uses a lightweight polymer (resin) frame and the world's first under rail as a standard, has a major impact on the style of tactical handguns that will appear in the future. It was.
Originally developed for the US market, USP's operation is close to handguns such as governments that are popular in the United States.

Tokyo Marui modelled Variant 1 with a combination of single & double action and control lever only on the left (with manual safety and de-cocking function) from a number of specification patterns. Based on the data measured from the real thing, the reproducibility is improved in every detail.

Major features

  • Large-diameter cylinder adoption
    A cylinder with a diameter of 15 mm is filled with gas for firing and blowback. Realised stable live performance and powerful blowback.
  • Safety & Decocking System
    By operating the control lever, it is possible to lock the hammer when it is in full cock (when it can be fired), and it is also possible to return from full cock to half cock in order to prevent it from falling out.
  • Reproduce the same operation as the real thing
    You can enjoy a single action that pulls the slide and raises the hammer to fire, and a double action that raises and fires the hammer just by pulling the trigger.
  • Metal extractor
    The extractor on the right side of the slide is reproduced with different parts. * Dummy that mimics only the appearance.
  • Under-mount rail included
    The under rail integrated with the frame is a unique standard. By attaching the included under-mount rail, it is possible to install a flashlight that supports the Picatinny standard with a width of 20 mm.
  • Ambi-type magazine catch lever
    Can be operated from either the left or right side.
  • Die-cast magazine
    Includes a die-cast magazine that resists cold.

“I wanna introduce you to a personal friend of mine. This is an M41A Pulse Rifle. Ten millimetre, with over-and-under thirty millimetre pump action grenade launcher.” ―Cpl. Hicks, to Ripley (from predominantly Aliens 1986 and in cameo on Alien 3 1992, used by the Weyland-Yutani commandos)

Meet the Snow Wolf M41A Pulse Rifle AEG. This weapon is a beautiful replica of the service rifle carried by the 22nd Century Colonial Marines in James Cameron’s iconic and Oscar winning big screen movies ‘Aliens and Aline 3’. The Digital countdown LED is fully functional, counting your shots down from 95 to zero, obviously this is a nice touch and purely a cosmetic feature. As the Gel Magazine will hold approximately 180-200 gels, depending on Gel Size.

The ammo counter on the gun is an operational unit that works with 9V batteries. The ammo counter starts off at 95 rounds, and will reset when you change magazines. If you wish to not use this function, you could remove the battery or switch it off. The gun also features a mock under barrel pump shotgun, but it is just for aesthetics, this is the battery compartment where you can insert your battery to power the rifle.

There are a plethora of 2011 style competition pistols on the market. Many of them are fine competition blasters, but they lack the rugged durability and dependability of a solid, reliable duty or personal defence weapon. Seeing this gap in the market, and already well known for making high performance, rugged weapon systems, Salient Arms set to work producing a double stack 1911 that could clean up at the competition range and defend your home or protect your life in the field. The end result of years of research was the Salient Arms DS 2011 pistol. Precision machined with a form follows function attitude the SAI DS was manufactured for no other purpose in mind then to fill the needs of the hardcore shooting enthusiast. Equipped with aggressive front and rear slide serrations, milled lightening cuts on both side of the slide and aggressive competition style sights the SAI DS clearly is a pistol designed for shooters by shooters. As with all of their products, Salient Arms rewrote the rules of 2011 style pistols when they manufactured the DS, forging a new trail and leaving old conventions behind, the end result is a pistol that functions in the harshest conditions, under the heaviest of stresses and provides performance you can stake your life on. 

EMG has extended their collaboration with the Salient Arms and is proud to release the Salient Arms x EMG DS 2011 collaboration gel ball Training pistol. Manufactured with an eye to detail the EMG SAI DS 2011 is CNC machined from aluminium alloy and features all of the trademarks of a Salient Arms pistol, including: a titanium nitride style barrel, competition style sights with fibre optic front insert, ambidextrous safety and, of course, stamped Salient Arms International roll marks. Utilizing the Tokyo Marui Hi-Capa gas system, the Salient Arms / EMG DS pistol can be upgraded from a wide pool of available parts and components, ensuring easy repair and maintenance and years of reliable performance.

products.title: KELe Derringer Remington Model 95 Replica Manual Plastic Dart Toy Pistol
products.body_html:
Specifications

The Classic Derringer, or more formally know and the Remington Model 95 Derringer, set the standard for concealable firearms at it’s time. The real-steel pistol, that this lovely little toy is based on, was easily carried by the gentleman of the time in a coat pocket, or by the Victorian Ladies of the era in their purse.

Discover the Timeless Elegance of the Remington Model 95 Double-Barrel Pocket Pistol, a Classic Derringer. This iconic firearm boasts a design that remained virtually unchanged throughout its remarkable 70-year production history. Production of the original pistol lasted from 1866, through to 1935, with over 150,000 being made. Explore its enduring charm today.

The original, was a single shot weapon, that carried a “spare” bullet in the second barrel. This plastic dart firing replica, discharges both barrel simultaneously, firing the small orange darts up to 12 meters. Once the trigger has been pulled, the toy needs to be reloaded with 2 fresh shells, with the plastic darts pushed in, until the spring inside the shell is locked, ready for the hammer to release, once fired.

KELe Derringer Remington Model 95 Replica Features:

  • Metal and Nylon body
  • Realistic Replica of the Classic Derringer
  • Spring Powered Shells
  • Orange Darts
  • Beautiful red velvet lined display box.

products.title: KELe Metal Colt 1873 Peacemaker Manual Revolver – Black
products.body_html:
Metal Body Version

Specifications

The Colt Single Action Army (also known as the SAA, Model P, Peacemaker, or M1873) is a single-action revolver handgun. It was designed for the U.S. government service revolver trials of 1872 by Colt’s Patent Firearms Manufacturing Company (today known as Colt’s Manufacturing Company) and was adopted as the standard-issued pistol of the U.S. Army from 1873 until 1892.

Its overall appearance has remained consistent since 1873. Colt has cancelled its production twice, but brought it back due to popular demand. The revolver was dubbed the “Peacemaker”, and is a famous piece of Americana and the American Wild West era, due to its popularity with ranchers, lawmen, and outlaws alike. Today, they are mainly bought as memorabilia by collectors and re-enactors. Its design has influenced the production of numerous other models from other companies.

The KELe range of spring manual pistols are next level in quality and these are no exception.  A full nylon and nylon built will definitely please both the bargain hunters and collectors alike.  These shoot gels or small foam darts from the imitation bullets, so you can really get into the spirit of gun slinging and target shooting. The The KELe Nylon Colt 1873 Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols are a single action trigger, meaning the hammer has to be cocked back, for each shot.

KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver Features:

  • Full Nylon body

USP (Universal Self-loading Pistol) developed by H&K in 1993 and strongly influenced the style of tactical handguns. The shortened model is USP compact.
Tokyo Marui modelled Variant 1 with a combination of single and double action, left-side control lever (with manual safety and de-cocking function), and Bobd Hammer, among other specification patterns. Based on the data measured from the real thing, the reproducibility is improved in every detail.

3D printed Mag Lip & Follower included for this model. By purchasing you're also covered by our life time guarantee on mag lips. If one breaks for any reason (at fault or not), you'll be given a new lip without hassle or issues.

Major features

  • Large-diameter cylinder adoption
    A cylinder with a diameter of 15 mm is filled with gas for firing and blow back. Realised stable live performance and powerful blow back.
  • Safety & Decoking System
    By operating the control lever, it is possible to lock the hammer when it is in full cock (when it can be fired), and it is also possible to return from full cock to half cock in order to prevent it from falling out.
  • Reproduce the same operation as the real thing
    You can enjoy a single action that pulls the slide and raises the hammer to fire, and a double action that raises and fires the hammer just by pulling the trigger.
  • Bobd Hammer
    Adopted Dehorned type Bobd Hammer that won't get caught in clothes when pulling out from holster.
  • Undermount rail included
    The under rail integrated with the frame is a unique standard. By attaching the included undermount rail, it is possible to install a flashlight that supports the Picatinny standard with a width of 20 mm.
  • Ambi-type magazine catch lever
    Can be operated from either the left or right side.
  • Die-cast magazine
    Includes magazines and a die-cast magazine that resists cold. A magazine bumper with a finger rest ensures stability when gripping. Magazine bumpers with finger rests can be replaced with the included flat mug plate.

Seeing over 100 years of service, John Browning's self-loading semi-automatic pistol design is arguably the most popular sidearm amongst Military, Law Enforcement, and Civilian circles. There is good reason why the 1911 is the longest running Military sidearm in the world; even today some of Americas most elite fighting units still choose to carry the venerable 1911 by their side. Its simple design made the sidearm easy to use and maintain making it a very rugged and reliable weapon. The success of the weapon has prompted many firearms manufacturers to borrow from the 1911 design; to this day the 1911 is still widely used as a benchmark when comparing sidearms.

Capable of Semi and Full Auto fire functions!

Features

  • This is the official licensed version authorized by TTI with full after-sales support. Every sale of this pistol benefits the original designer. Support licensed products and better products!
  • Highly detailed CNC machined aluminium slide w/ officially licensed TTI laser engraved markings
  • CNC machined aluminium frame w/ moulded reinforced polymer grips & lower 1913 Picatinny rails
  • Optic mounting plate supports RMR-pattern red dot sights for faster, easier aiming
  • Mounting plate cover lets you protect the threads & mounting posts when not in use
  • Precision CNC aluminium 5" outer barrel w/ rose gold (imitation Bronze BLC) coating & two port compensator
  • TTI professional slide lightening cuts help the slide cycle faster with less felt muzzle flip
  • Flared mag well aids in quick reloads

Taran Tactical Innovations is a name synonymous with ultra high performance gun customization and competition inspired accessories. Taran Butler, the founder of Taran Tactical Innovations is a world renown shooter that has more championship titles across a myriad of competitions than anyone else. An expert with pistols, rifles, and shotguns, Taran Butler holds the title of Grandmaster in both pistol and multi-gun, which further highlights his pedigree in the shooting sports. His expertise as a competitive shooter and as a trainer has given him the insight to spotting crucial areas of improvement for each weapon platform he chooses to run. products.title: E&C XM177E2 MACVSOG Rifle EC-325 GREY Gel Blaster
products.body_html:
The CAR-15 XM177 or CAR-15 Commando was a part of the CAR-15 Military Weapons System designed in 1966 in response to the US military's desire for a compact M16 variant to improve on the inadequacies of earlier shortened M16 types.

Although the United States had already tested the CAR-15 Model 607 submachine gun in Vietnam, it had a number of shortcomings, including overwhelming muzzle blast and an overly complicated, unreliable collapsible stock. Colt came up with the XM177, which featured a number of improvements, to address the shortcomings.

The triangular collapsible stock was replaced with a simpler two-position telescoping tubular aluminium buttstock, while the fragile improvised handguards of the Model 607 were replaced by reinforced round handguards. Each half of the round handguard is identical, simplifying logistics by not requiring a top/bottom or left/right pair. The Model 609 Commando has a forward assist, while the Model 610 Commando does not. A Model 610B with a four-position selector was available, but not used by the U.S. military. All versions are equipped with the 4.25-inch (108 mm) long moderator.

Features

    • Full metal receiver and barrel assembly
    • Durable polymer hand guard, stock, and pistol grip

products.title: Snow Wolf Aug Steyr Magazine
products.body_html:
Specifications

Introducing the Snow Wolf Aug Steyr magazine. This item is a direct OEM product, which can be used as either a spare for more time on the field, or replacement, should you damage the magazine that came with you Snow Wolf Aug Steyer.

The magazine is designed to be predominantly fed by the sprung loaded feeding plates, which push the gels to the top of the mag, where the feeder wheel is the only item that runs off the battery power of the blaster. This innovative design, ensures that all the parts that are susceptible to water damage, namely the motor and electronic components are at the top of the magazine. Away from where water would collect and reduce the life of standard style AEG Mags, where the motor and electronics would be at the bottom of the mag.

This should increase the life of the magazine considerably, as compare to a standard type AEG Magazine, as the motor and electronic are kept high and dry.

Armee-Universal-Gewehr (Universal Army Rifle) or AUG is a futuristic assault rifle developed during the 1960s in Austria to replace the aging 7.62mm FAL automatic rifles in service at the time.
Often considered as the first successful bullpup rifle, the AUG was indeed well ahead of its time as far as concept and design; it was highly advanced when it first went into service in the late 1970s.
Its bullpup design which moves the core of the rifles action behind the trigger allows for the use of a full length rifle barrel in a weapon with the ergonomics of a sub-machine gun. Some other significant features include fully ambidextrous controls and reversible charging handle and shell ejection port allowing the rifle to be configured for both left and right handed shooters. The unique two stage trigger allows the user to fire in semi-auto and full-auto without needing to manipulate a selector switch; for semi-automatic fire, the operator will just pull the trigger half way and if fully-automatic fire was necessary, the operator needs to only pull the trigger all the way back.Chambered in the 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge for its ease of use and handling, the futuristic family of rifles in the AUG line can be quickly adapted to accommodate a wide variety of roles in the ever changing battlefield with just a quick swap of the barrel. The AUG is definitely a well-rounded combat weapon with a proven track record that can stand its own even with todays modern combat rifles.

Licensed gel blaster replica of the well-known Belgian subcompact carbine FN SCAR-SC, produced by Fabrique Nationale de Herstal. The SCAR-SC is one of the most recognizable and iconic firearm models manufactured by FN Herstal. Its distinctive design and compact size make it ideal for use by special forces and counter-terrorism units in hostage rescue operations and Close-quarters combat (CQC).

The CYMA replica of the SCAR-SC, licensed by CYBERGUN, is an exact reproduction of the original model. The collaboration between these two companies has resulted in a licensed model that offers good-quality craftsmanship at an affordable price. This allows both gel blaster enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy owning this renowned replica, whether they engage in gelsoft sports or simply appreciate unique replicas.

Similar to the original SCAR, the replica is primarily made of aluminium and polymer. The upper receiver, barrel, stock, rail systems, and other smaller components are made of aluminium and other metal alloys, while the lower receiver, pistol grip, and stock pad are made of polymer, just like the real thing. The FN SCAR CQC rifle was designed as an ambidextrous weapon to meet the requirements of special forces and provide reliability and mobility during military operations. The gel blaster SCAR-SC follows suit, featuring an ambidextrous fire selector lever, an ambi magazine release, sling attachment points, and a reversible charging handle.

products.title: Custom Tokyo Marui / Guarder Aluminium USP Compact Gel Blaster
products.body_html:
Tokyo Marui USP Custom Built utilising Upgraded Parts; Guarder

Australia's FIRST Alloy USP Compact Gas Pistol!

Please allow time for any Custom Gas Pistol to be built and tested. Some are pre built ready to go and so we may take a few days to ensure all built parts are up to working order with our testing prior to it leaving the shop.

Listed below are the Upgrade parts utilised in the build 

Includes FREE Pistol Case

Base Model : Tokyo Marui USP Compact

Upgraded Features

  • Guarder CNC Aluminium Slide
  • Guarder Steel Extractor
  • Guarder Recoil Spring 150%
  • Guarder Hammer Spring 150%

USP (Universal Self-loading Pistol) developed by H&K in 1993 and strongly influenced the style of tactical handguns. The shortened model is USP compact.
Tokyo Marui modelled Variant 1 with a combination of single and double action, left-side control lever (with manual safety and de-cocking function), and Bobd Hammer, among other specification patterns. Based on the data measured from the real thing, the reproducibility is improved in every detail.

3D printed Mag Lip & Follower included for this model. By purchasing you're also covered by our life time guarantee on mag lips. If one breaks for any reason (at fault or not), you'll be given a new lip without hassle or issues.

products.title: Nine Ball High Bullet Valve NEO R Hi Capa Series/M4A1 MWS/M1911/M45A1/FN5-7
products.body_html:
Hi-CAPA High Power Airsoft Gas Valve(Green Gas)

Building upon the success from our “High Bullet Valve Neo R” this valve is optimized for use with high-pressure gas such as green gas. Improving upon the original design, the tip of the valve shaft has been redesigned to stabilize the shooting performance.
Adjusting the aperture which controls the gas flow remains the same as seen from our  “High Bullet Valve Neo R”.  The step less adjustment of aperture width from full aperture to minimum aperture is simple and stress free. When the valve is opened fully, the gas flow will increase to the same level as those from power up valves giving you added kick and increased velocity. Conversely, when the valve is tightened, the stability of velocity and the gas efficiency will improve, optimizing it for shooters looking for consistent accuracy.
This valve also improves upon a wide range of quality-of-life changes.  From noise reduction of the mechanism, to shooters looking to reduce parts wear from high-temperature / high-pressure conditions.

Short history
CZ-75 is Czechoslovak origin and is a pistol designed in 1975 by Koucky brothers, who at that time worked in the Ceska Zbrojovka national arms factories. Production of this gun began in 1976 and was a success in the weapons world. CZ-75 platform was able to meet the best qualities of that time. The pistol design, comfort and reliability especially recommended it worldwide. The pistol was so appreciated that more weapons manufacturers have copied the base platform, so the principle CZ-75 can be found at 941- Israeli Jericho, TZ-75's Italian but also at others. This pistol was adopted by the Turkish armed forces, some states in the US and other countries worldwide.

Exterior of the replica
This replica manufactured by KJ Works copies the real weapon details. The operation of this replica is very similar to real one. The recoil is strong and manage to impress the War game players. It is made of metal and the handle grips are made of resistant plastic ABS. On the left side there are the command like: slide catch, safety and mag catch, thus this pistol is recommended for right-handed users. The pistol sights are fixed and well orientated.

Interior of the replica
The internal mechanisms of this Gel Blaster are made from quality metal and therefore is wear resistant and reliable over time. 

Power source
This pistol replica works on Green Gas, can work with weaker gas variants but not stronger as this may damage the replica. In optimal temperature and operating conditions, with a full of gas the replica is able to act the entire magazine and block the slide to empty position. Performance levels are achieved at ambient temperatures exceeding 15°C.

Gas Type: Duster gas, ie 144a, OR 12kg Green Gas is recommended for this pistol - PLEASE NOTE USING C02 IN THIS PISTOL WILL VOID WARRANTY.

products.title: Geissele MK8 10.5 inch MWS (ZET System) Gas Blowback Rifle Gel Blaster
products.body_html:
Introducing the Geissele MK8 MWS Gel Blaster by Western Manufacturing. This gas blowback rifle sets new standards in the world of gel blasters, delivering an unparalleled experience that will leave you in awe.

Providing the utmost assurance in both material quality and performance. This gel blaster is equipped with a top-tier alloy bolt and a steel trigger box, along with WM's latest-designed buffer, offering a smooth and powerful recoil experience. Moreover, the stainless steel inner barrel features an adjustable hop-up design, allowing you to customize the hop-up effect as desired. The length of the inner barrel is perfectly matched to the tracer unit, ensuring optimal performance.

Crafted with precision, the Geissele MK8 MWS Gel Blaster boasts a remarkable anodizing finish on its receiver, exuding an aura of sophistication and elegance. Its sturdy build surprises anyone who holds it for the first time, defying expectations of being lightweight. Embodying the legacy of its real-steel counterpart, this gel blaster captures the essence of authenticity in both form and function.

Using 12kg gas, this WM creation achieves consistent shooting at approximately 320 fps, remaining within limits in many fields. It kicks hard and its reliable performance remains pleasantly surprising. With hardly any signs of immediate cooldown during full-auto firing, you can confidently dominate the field without any worries.

The reason for the extended development process becomes apparent when you observe the engineering marvel of the ZET system incorporated in the bolt carrier. Tracer or Torch?? The DC-5 Series means you don’t need to chose; take both!

Our DC-5 Series Surefire Holster uses your attached torch for retention, meaning you can run your favourite tracer alongside your torch. If you run the same torch on multiple weapons, then this is the holster for you. After extensive testing of over 150 pistols, we only found 3 pistols that wouldn’t fit; the full size Desert Eagle, ASG USW and the Hudson. Our DC-5 Series will fit the bigger frame guns, like the FNX pistols, weapons with wide trigger guards, like the AAP and pistols with taller slides like the 1911.

This MK23 Kydex DC1 Series Holster is a true game changer in the industry. Finally a solid mounting platform is available that doesn’t rely on cheep injection moulded / 3d printed plastic.   • Sleek Aesthetics: The full colour scheme sets this blaster apart, making it a stylish choice for gel blasting enthusiasts.
  • Enhanced Durability: Compared to the V3, the V4 boasts an upgraded nylon construction, guaranteeing a stronger and more robust body material.

  • Improved Magazine Terminals: Enjoy upgraded mag terminals that ensure smooth, reliable magazine swaps during intense battles.

products.title: Custom Inner Barrel for E&C Barrel Chamber
products.body_html:
Custom 7.1mm Inner Diameter Barrels.

Inner Barrels are cut to spec based on the brand of Inner Barrel Housing/Chamber of your Gas Pistol. Please select the correct option for you.

When purchasing, leave a note in your order advising us what pistol this is for (include brand and name please) as Outer Diameters on barrels are different depending on the brand of Pistol you're using. This is so we can make the correct notches to fit the Chamber and Outer Barrel set up of your pistol. If unsure, contact us with a photo of your gel blaster.

Also include as a note the length of barrel you'd like if wanting specific size. This doesn't cost any extra. If no note for barrel length, we'll cut to the spec you've selected.

Some spec inner barrels will require your inner barrel lathed down to fit within the Outer Barrel. Therefore, colour of barrel will be different than photographed.

We currently make these barrels to suit a wide variety of pistol brands such as;

  • Tokyo Marui
  • Guarder
  • E&C
  • Army Armament
  • Armourer Works
  • We Tech
  • Killer Innovations
  • GBF
  • Double Bell
  • Golden Eagle

For anything specific, OR if you're unsure, please contact us and we'll work with you for correct measurements.

products.title: PDX Maxim CA-12 Gel Blaster – Black

Introducing the Ultimate Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster – Unleash Your Tactical Skills

Looking for an adrenaline-pumping, action-packed experience? Look no further than the Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster. Built with cutting-edge technology and designed for thrill-seekers, this gel blaster is guaranteed to take your tactical gameplay to the next level.

With its sleek and ergonomic design, the Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster offers unparalleled comfort and control. Whether you’re engaging in intense outdoor battles or competing in close-quarters indoor skirmishes, this blaster is your perfect companion. Its compact size ensures easy manoeuvrability, allowing you to dominate any battlefield with precision and finesse.

The Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster boasts a reasonably powerful and reliable shooting mechanism out of the box, ensuring consistent and accurate shots every time. It offers semi and full auto fire modes. Experience the thrill of rapid-fire action as you unleash a barrage of gels, leaving your opponents in awe.

Safety is a top priority, and the Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster excels in this area. It features a reliable safety lock system, ensuring that the blaster is only activated when you’re ready to fire. Additionally, it uses biodegradable Gels, making it environmentally friendly while still delivering an intense and satisfying impact.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of tactical warfare like never before. The Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster is engineered to provide an unparalleled gaming experience. Whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just starting your gel blasting journey, this blaster will exceed your expectations.

Unlock your full potential on the battlefield and command attention with the Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster. Take your tactical skills to new heights and leave your competitors in awe. Experience the thrill today!

Jingji Maxim PDX Gel Blaster is the one of the latest short barrel CQB style blasters to hit the market.  This has been built with the player in mind with meticulous attention to detail and offers a range of game play options for those looking for the speedball field or the milsim style play.  The body is super solid nylon built and runs a v2 nylon gearbox shell with metal gears.  This means it can take a 11.1v battery with easy and comes with a XT30 plug for extra safety and peace of mind.  Built to the level of quality you can expect from Jingji after their SRL range of gel blasters, the gel ball community have grown to love.   The great thing about this gel blaster is also the upgrade compatibility with v2 components and also the SLR mags.

Specially designed for compactness without sacrificing performance and quality, the Maxim PDX sets a new benchmark in the CQB gel blaster range.

products.title: Tokyo Marui Desert Eagle Chrome Gel Blaster
products.body_html:
The Desert Eagle includes a FREE Pistol Case

Original Magazine utilising HFC Mag Lip & Bucking

Perfect for use with Green Gas!

Magnum Auto “Desert Eagle” launches the largest handgun .50AE bullet. In order to reproduce this powerful force, a dedicated hard kick and gas blowback engine was installed to reproduce the reaction that could not be controlled with one hand.

Hard chrome plating is applied to the whole body, and it has a beautiful contrast with the rubber type grip.

The Desert Eagle is undoubtedly one of the largest and hardest kicking hand blasters on the Gel Blaster market today. Manufactured by IMI since 1984 in real steel format, the Desert Eagle was actually designed by American firm Magnum Research in Minneapolis, USA. The large framed blaster recoils with a menacing kick each time the trigger is pulled. Strong recoil spring means that the slide locks back into place with a crisp and solid report. Being one of the most satisfying Gel Blasters to look at and to shoot, it's no wonder the TM Desert Eagle has always been one of TM's top sellers.

Major features

  • Hard kick and gas blowback
    A special ultra-large cylinder has been newly developed to achieve the largest blowback in the series.
  • IMI official license
    Obtained a license from Israel Military Industry, the manufacturer of dessert eagle, and the stamp is also realistically reproduced.
  • Large magazine included
    A special magazine with a large gas capacity is included to create a powerful blowback.

Specification

  • FPS: 320
  • Build Material : ABS
  • Magazine Capacity : 12-15
  • Length : 270mm
  • Barrel Length : 136mm
  • Weight : 1110g
  • System: Gas Blowback
  • Fire Mode : Semi Auto-Auto
  • Package Includes : Blaster, Magazine

Gas Type: Duster gas, ie 144a, is recommended for this pistol OR 12kg Green Gas - PLEASE NOTE USING C02 IN THIS PISTOL WILL VOID WARRANTY - We highly recommend getting a metal slide to run green gas.

Magazine Compatibility:

Tokyo Marui Desert Eagle Magazines Series
HFC Desert Eagle Magazine

GEL GROWTH

  • We've Tested working; SUMMER CAT Greens/Blues/Frosts/Whites for no more than 2:10hr grow in water. Other hardened gels may work with various optimised growing times. Keep in mind consistency of gel size is key to a full functioning Gel Blaster with minimal splitting or miss feeds.  

    3 Month Warranty on this product with proper use and Maintenance. Misuse will void your warranty.

products.title: Tokyo Marui FNX-45 Tactical Gel Blaster - FDE
products.body_html:
Includes Free Pistol Case

Note: Current mag lips design does allow for slide lock. 

3D printed Mag Lip & Follower included for this model. By purchasing you're also covered by our life time guarantee on mag lips. If one breaks for any reason (at fault or not), you'll be given a new lip without hassle or issues.

FNP-45 tactical developed with the aim of side arms for special forces of the US Army. The improved model “FNX-45 Tactical” is now available in the gas blowback series!

A model that enhances the reproducibility of details and functions unique to this model, such as ambi type levers, replaceable back straps, pursuit of reality by measuring the real thing, as well as high expandability corresponding to various optional parts It has become.

Major features

  • Compatible with optional Micro Dot Sight
    The slide is designed exclusively for mounting Micro Dot Sight (sold separately). If you remove the cover at the rear of the slide, you can attach the micro Dot Sight directly. In addition, the front / rear sight is a toll type night sight specification, and sighting is possible even through a micro-Dot Sight.
  • Compatible with optional tactical silencer
    By removing the muzzle protector from the muzzle, you can install the “Tactical Silencer” that will be sold separately. A metal outer barrel is used to provide sufficient durability for the silencer installation.
  • Newly designed oval piston

products.title: Custom Inner Barrel for Tokyo Marui Barrel Chamber
products.body_html:
Custom 7.1mm Inner Diameter Barrels.

Inner Barrels are cut to spec based on the brand of Inner Barrel Housing/Chamber of your Gas Pistol. Please select the correct option for you.

When purchasing, leave a note in your order advising us what pistol this is for (include brand and name please) as Outer Diameters on barrels are different depending on the brand of Pistol you're using. This is so we can make the correct notches to fit the Chamber and Outer Barrel set up of your pistol. If unsure, contact us with a photo of your gel blaster.

Also include as a note the length of barrel you'd like if wanting specific size. This doesn't cost any extra. If no note for barrel length, we'll cut to the spec you've selected.

Some spec inner barrels will require your inner barrel lathed down to fit within the Outer Barrel. Therefore, colour of barrel will be different than photographed.

We currently make these barrels to suit a wide variety of pistol brands such as;

products.title: Nine Ball SOCOM Mk23 Light Trigger Pull Kit w/ Green Gas Valve
products.body_html:
SOCOM MK23 Lightweight Trigger Kit INTERNATIONAL Version (Green Gas)

●Fine tuned trigger unit for the perfect balance of speed and performance
●High-grade and light-weight duralumin build
●Keep your aim on target with a shorter reset and lighter wall

The NineBall Mk23 Lightweight Trigger kit aims to optimize and recalibrate the settings of the Socom Mk23 by fine tuning both the trigger unit itself and modifying the gas system. The lightweight hammer and hammer spring decrease the amount of force required to reciprocate the trigger mechanism, making for a exceptionally lighter trigger pull. The shorter travel between the wall and reset greatly reduce the amount of movement made between shots, keeping your shots on point every time.

To compensate for the reduced force required to action the trigger, we've also re-engineering the knocker and the gas valve to suit green gas. The result is the perfect balance of lightened trigger pull, gas efficiency, and pristine performance. No more heavy triggers, optimize your Mk23 today!

■Brand: Nine Ball

■Included: 
・Lightweight Hammer x1
・Short stroked knocker x1
・Lightweight Hammer Spring x1
・Specialty Green Gas Valve x1

※IMPORTANT: Please note that the included valve, is REQUIRED for the system to function while using Green Gas, failure to install the valve in your magazines may lead to malfunctions or failure to cycle. Spare valves for spare magazines are also available separately.

■Compatibility: Tokyo Marui Spec MK23

products.title: Nine Ball SOCOM Mk23 High Bullet Valve NEO RR
products.body_html:
Nine Ball SOCOM Mk23 High Bullet Valve NEO RR

While inheriting the performance of our company's "High Bullet Valve NEO R", it is a high bullet valve whose structure has been optimized according to the "Tokyo Marui SOCOM Mk23 Light Trigger Pull Kit". Equipped with a variable mechanism that can steplessly adjust the characteristic opening range of the NEO R series high bullet valve from fully open to just before fully closed! Conversely, by narrowing the opening of the valve, the stability of bullet speed and fuel efficiency are improved, so it is suitable for shooters who want stable accuracy. In addition, it can be applied to reduce noise during operation and to prevent damage at high temperature and high pressure, realizing a wide range of settings according to the usage environment and operating conditions.

Required tools: Our "Valve Wrench NEO"

■Compatibility: Tokyo Marui Spec MK23

products.title: Nine Ball Hi-Capa Gas Route Seal Bucking ・ AERO Hi-CAPA Series / P226
products.body_html:
Tokyo Marui Gas Root Seal Packing Aero (1 piece)
Designed for Hi Capa & SIG P226 Magazines

 

● Internal aero shape reduces gas passage resistance!
●Material with excellent sliding properties and special surface treatment!!

-Cold-resistant material that reduces gas leakage! The gas blowback handgun uses gas pressure to fire BB bullets, then retract the slide to load the next bullet. To put it simply, this is the only thing, but by achieving a balance between the "flow rate", "instantaneous pressure" and "flow velocity" of the gas, a realistic gimmick and recoil that follow the same firing process as a real gun are created. The most important part for sending the gas, which is the power source, to the gun is the gasket, which is the point of contact between the magazine and the gun.

The release of gas, which momentarily becomes minus temperature, hardens the gasket part with cold air at once, which reduces the adhesion and makes it easier to cause gas leakage. In addition, if the adhesion tension that does not leak gas and the sliding balance when moving the slide are not compatible, it will affect recoil, operability, and power during blowback. Furthermore, the size, internal shape, and positional relationship of the gas discharge port are also important. It may also cause a decrease in speed, unevenness in impact, and deterioration of fuel consumption. This item has high slide-ability and reduces gas leakage with "elaborate crimp tension" and "gas leakage suppression ribs" on the side.

Also, based on a huge amount of bullet speed test data and blowback feeling, we decided the most suitable ejection port size and positional relationship. Furthermore, the smooth streamline shape that reduces the passage resistance of the internal gas route achieves an exquisite total balance of flow rate, pressure, and flow velocity. A cold-resistant grade material that is resistant to cold weather is used for the material, realizing flexible and delicate crimping tension! In addition, by mixing a special slip agent into the material and applying a special surface treatment that reduces frictional resistance and makes it easier for oil to stay, it has excellent slip characteristics and a significantly longer life without oil! Of course, the size of the ejection port and the position of the hole are determined based on a huge amount of bullet speed test data and blowback feeling! The highlight of this item and the most notable part is the smooth internal aero shape that reduces gas passage resistance! By combining all of these, it will be the first item with excellent total balance!

■Compatibility: Tokyo Marui Spec GBB Series  / SIG P226

products.title: Dr Black Stainless Steel S303 Hammer Protection Pad for Hi Capa 4.3
products.body_html:
Keep your Hi Capa 5.1 pistol in tip-top shape with the Dr. Black Stainless Steel S303 Hammer Protection Pad. Made from incredibly durable S303 steel, this precision CNC machined pad is designed to protect your hammer housing from deformation caused by the hammer's impact, ensuring consistent operation and preventing performance issues. Compatible with Marui, WE/AW, Army Armament Hi-Capa 4.3, and M1911 models, this hammer pad is a fantastic investment in the longevity of your pistol.

Installation is simple: just remove the original screw securing the blowback unit from the back of the slide, set the hammer pad in place, and screw in the included longer screw to secure both the pad and the blowback unit. The hammer pad does not affect the pistol's performance, slide cycle, gas efficiency, or trigger pull, allowing you to enjoy the same smooth shooting experience you've come to expect from your Hi Capa 5.1.

Pair this hammer pad with other Dr. Black upgrades to maximize the benefits and performance of your Hi Capa 5.1 pistol. With no known issues and compatibility across a wide range of models, the Dr. Black Stainless Steel S303 Hammer Protection Pad is an essential addition to your arsenal.

Features

  • Compatible with Marui, WE/AW, Army Armament Hi-Capa 4.3 and M1911 models
  • Protects hammer housing from impact wear
  • Maintains consistent operation of hammer impact
  • Easy installation with included longer screw
  • Does not affect performance or trigger pull

products.title: Warwolf Green Gas W4 14kg
products.body_html:
Basic information :

Volume: 1680ml

Material: GH2FCF3CH3

Purity: 99.7%

Silicone oil content: 1.8%

Acid content: 0.0001%

Water content: 0.005%

Features:

Easy to carry on the field.

Stable and safe to use.

Ready to go right out of the box, no mixing necessary.

Can be used with all gel blaster green gas-powered guns.

Powers your green gas gel blaster guns while lubricating with silicone oil .

Green  Gas is used as a propellant for airsoft and gel blaster guns. It is an alternative source of power as opposed to spring- or motor-driven airsoft weapons. Green gas is higher pressured gas suitable for metal slide guns and plastic slide guns. The gas type you need to use on bolt action gas sniper rifles depends on the FPS power you require. Green Gas can be used to power all Airsoft and gel blaster guns without the risk of damage, thanks to its optimally levelled pressure. It also contains silicone oil which protects and lubricates elements of your gun. Works in Low Temperature . Enhanced Formula. Up To +20 Fps. Powers Your Blow Back System.

products.title: Custom AAP-01 GBB Gel Blaster Grey Assassin
products.body_html:
Customised AAP01 Utilising CTM and AAP coloured brand parts.

No Mag Provided. Requires your own AAP-01 Magazine

Custom Build

  • CTM-TAC Superlight Bolt/BBU
  • CNC Aluminium Rear Upper
  • CNC Aluminium Front Outer Barrel Type 6
  • CNC Aluminium Rail Set
  • Titanium Tactical Industry CNC Selector Switch + Charge Handle
  • Titanium Tactical Industry CNC Adjustable Trigger
  • Titanium Tactical Industry CNC Aluminium Magwell

Although the AAP-01 Assassin is Action Army’s own design, its rather unique looks are based largely on the Ruger Mark IV, a 22 calibre target pistol known for its vintage shape and competition-level accuracy.

Unlike the Mark IV, however, Action army has cut various grooves and channels into the AAP-01’s frame and outer barrel, making it a little easier to grip when racking and gives it a little bit more of an angular look.   The gun itself is a little shorter and, being made of polymer rather than metal, is considerably more lightweight  but good use of metal internally in the bolt, barrel and magazine giving it decent weight but not making it too heavy.

This gel blaster pistol has been highly anticipated by many players for it’s light yet fast blowback action and loads of upgrade accessories.  It also has the ability to shoot in semi auto or full auto with the click of a switch and since it uses standard Glock -series magazines you should be able to easily find higher capacity extended mags or at least extra mags when needed.

Stormbreaka Hi-Capa Version

Poseidon M4 Adapter Hi-Capa Version

Stormbreaka is the 1st generation RPM Tech M4 adapter. It is designed to fit most gel blaster AEG m4 mags. Mags are controlled by an FCU.

We have 5 main colours: Black, Silver, Red, Blue, and Purple. 

Any Gen 8 style mags are compatible, such as SLR mag, War Interest mag, Universal mag, or drum mag, etc.

Material: CNC machined aluminium

The Sensitivity Adjustment Knob can only turn 270 degrees!!!

Sensitivity Adjustment: Left Knob

Turn Right: Increase sensitivity

Turn Left: Reduce sensitivity

Loading Speed Adjustment: Right Button

4 levels, Flash Light Indication

The higher the level, the longer the loading time.

This adapter allows you to use HPA (high-pressure air) and M4 AEG magazines on your Poseidon pistol. To use it you will also need an M4 AEG magazine, a “paintball” tank with a low-pressure regulator (0-120 psi), and a hose with a Foster quick disconnect. The normal operating pressure for green gas is roughly 120 psi depending on the temperature. We recommend that you run your pistol near this pressure and do not exceed 120 psi. Keep in mind that higher pressures can cause excessive wear and damage to the internal components of your pistol.

We recommend that you use high-speed M4 AEG magazines for the most consistent performance.

products.title: EMG / Salient Arms International™ 2011 DS Pistol 4.3 Hi Capa Gel Blaster Black
products.body_html:
There are a plethora of 2011 style competition pistols on the market. Many of them are fine competition blasters, but they lack the rugged durability and dependability of a solid, reliable duty or personal defence weapon. Seeing this gap in the market, and already well known for making high performance, rugged weapon systems, Salient Arms set to work producing a double stack 1911 that could clean up at the competition range and defend your home or protect your life in the field. The end result of years of research was the Salient Arms DS 2011 pistol. Precision machined with a form follows function attitude the SAI DS was manufactured for no other purpose in mind then to fill the needs of the hardcore shooting enthusiast. Equipped with aggressive front and rear slide serrations, milled lightening cuts on both side of the slide and aggressive competition style sights the SAI DS clearly is a pistol designed for shooters by shooters. As with all of their products, Salient Arms rewrote the rules of 2011 style pistols when they manufactured the DS, forging a new trail and leaving old conventions behind, the end result is a pistol that functions in the harshest conditions, under the heaviest of stresses and provides performance you can stake your life on. 

EMG has extended their collaboration with the Salient Arms and is proud to release the Salient Arms x EMG DS 2011 collaboration gel ball Training pistol. Manufactured with an eye to detail the EMG SAI DS 2011 is CNC machined from aluminium alloy and features all of the trademarks of a Salient Arms pistol, including: a titanium nitride style barrel, competition style sights with fibre optic front insert, ambidextrous safety and, of course, stamped Salient Arms International roll marks. Utilizing the Tokyo Marui Hi-Capa gas system, the Salient Arms / EMG DS pistol can be upgraded from a wide pool of available parts and components, ensuring easy repair and maintenance and years of reliable performance. 

 

    Package Include : 

    1 x SA-DS0200-GB
    1 x SA-DSMG01-GB Magazine

products.title: Aztech 8mm Low Profile Bushes 440 Stainless V2 Gearbox for Gel Ball
products.body_html:
Custom made CNC bushes by Aztech Innovations

Manufactured from 440 grade stainless steel with rock well hardness of 60HRC

Machined to 8mm (8.02mm ) to within 0.001mm tolerances. These are made .02 of a mm oversize to ensure a snug fit with out warping the gearbox from over tension. 

We recommend a light press or bearing tool for installation. Do not Impact with a hammer or blunt force tooling to ensure no damage is caused to the gearbox.  We highly recommend using a JB Weld Original epoxy as an adhesive to bond the bushes into place to ensure they can not move or come loose in the gearbox.

Suits V2 and V3 style gearbox's - gel ball and airsoft compatible.  May be too shallow for some nylon gearboxes to be securely retained.
These do not suit Singularity 13 Gen 8 Gearboxes.

Includes 6x Bushes

Stainless bushes must be lubricated with a high quality bearing and gear grease.  We highly recommend Nulon Xtreme Performance Grease with PTFE (L80) which is a blend of Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) fluorocarbon particles in a specially prepared lithium-based, water-repellent grease. 

PTFE L80 keeps water and dust out while a plating of PTFE is applied to the mating surfaces under working conditions. Seal performance is improved and operating temperature reduced, resulting in less grease "throw". L80 is the perfect grease for our CNC bushes and gears.

L80 has a continuous temperature operating range of -9°C to 150°C

products.title: Acetech BiFrost
products.body_html:
The new ACETECH BiFROST tracer unit supports green and water gels. The unit comes in 11 modes in total and loops in the following sequence :
1  Red/Orange/Yellow/Green/Blue/Pink/Purple Beam and Flame .  The Flame LED flashes the colour of the mode switched to.

2  RGB Beam/Flame – The flame LED flashes R/G/B for once

3  Rainbow Beam/Flame – This flame LED flashes white twice

4 Rainbow Dynamic – The Flame LED flashes white three times.

5 Demo – The flame LED flashes white for four times

6 Turn OFF – Turn Off flame functions.  The Power indicator flashes green for three times or keeps blinking.

  • Unit simulates muzzle flash, the effect of flame depends on volume of gas or water fog around the muzzle, with more volume, effect will be better
  • Smart Power Saving System: Shake and Wake for quicker kick-off.
  • BBs Support: Green Tracer BBs and Water Gel BBs
  • Large Battery: Fully charged battery would last over 20000 rounds on Tracer mode only.

Disclaimer: Do not shine directly into human eyes. Not a toy. Keep away from Children.

Inner Barrels are cut to spec based on the brand of Inner Barrel Housing/Chamber of your Gas Pistol. Please select the correct option for you.

When purchasing, leave a note in your order advising us what pistol this is for (include brand and name please) as Outer Diameters on barrels are different depending on the brand of Pistol you're using. Some spec inner barrels will require your inner barrel lathed down to fit within the Outer Barrel. Therefore, colour of barrel will be different than photographed.

  • Metal notch spacer

products.title: Tokyo Marui HK MK23 NBBG Pistol
products.body_html:
Now Available!

 

MK23 Non Blow Back Gas Pistol. These are the quietest Gel Blaster on the market. The Slide is fixed and does not move when firing.

Tokyo Marui MK23 SOCOM Non-Blowback Gas Pistol

Black Mag Lip is a Durable Resin Print in an ABS-like compound included for this model. By purchasing you're also covered by our life time guarantee on mag lips with proper use.

MK23 Magazine has been optimised for Gel Double Stack Loading & Feeding. We're currently using Cut Stock Mag Springs with Custom Designed Follower to best suit current Mag Lip iteration. This allows the best Double Stack and Feeding solution. All releases of Magazines work with each MK23 Blaster (IE current and original JAN 2025 release)

Inner Barrel includes fluted hop. Other length options will be available in the future once further testing for compatibility is completed. IE; Lengthened Inner Barrel into Suppressor or Flush Barrel options.

Hit Caller Hopped Inner Barrel Now Available. We strongly recommend one of these for those looking to use the included Suppressor

Check out our Firing Sample here

The TM MK23 is an iconic pistol, taken to the next level of performance. This TM SOCOM is also one of the most popular primary weapons among the sniper community. Other than it’s superb range and accuracy, what truly sets this pistol apart from the rest is how quiet it is. Marui has achieved this through its non-blowback system, and it’s large SOCOM style damping foam-filled suppressor. There’s nothing more satisfying than flinging Gels down at your opponents from a sneaky 10m away, and they never figure out where you are!

TM’s NBB system also contributes to making it one of the most gas efficient pistols on the market. The MK23 easily pumps out heaps of shots per magazine, without suffering from massive velocity drop! Included in the package is a functional tac light to properly complete the SOCOM silhouette. (Batteries not included) Don’t just take our word for it, this pistol has earned itself a place in the hall of fame worldwide!

Among the fans, the initial model of the Socom Mark 23, called the legendary gun, is lined up with a silencer and L.A.M. (= light attachment module) as a full set of gas guns. All of these are stored in hard containers and gun cases, making it a special set that looks like a figure delivered to the elite.
The combination of the Socom Mark 23 main body and silencer, which has been slid on the slide operation, demonstrates outstanding silence among all products. While enhancing the practicality of the game youth, it reproduces the power of the appearance by mounting the light attachment module, making it an ideal model for collections.

Major features

  • Full set of gun case storage
    SOCOM Mark 23 and dedicated suppressor, L.A.M. are stored in a hard container gun case. The fun of opening the package and assembling it fully equipped is exceptional.
  • Excellent silence
    By mounting a silencer on a fixed slide gas gun that suppresses operation noise, even the firing sound is reduced. This model has excellent concealment.
  • Detachable L.A.M .
    The attached L.A.M. can be attached to the original under rail integrated with the frame. In addition, the L.A.M. flashlight uses a high-intensity white LED, and the laser-irradiated part can be turned on with a dummy LED to enhance the atmosphere.
  • Die-casting real-size magazine
    Includes die-casting magazine that resists cold.
  • Compatible with Tokyo Marui 16mm CW Suppressor
  • Amount of Shots of Gas per Fill when firing with Gels : 100+ Shots
  • Best Gels for optimised use with any length barrel; Summer Cats Blue or Green when grown for 2hr 10mins and sized to 7.2mm

  • FPS: 290-320 Pending Inner Barrel length. 350+ if choosing to run an Inner Barrel half way+ into the Suppressor
